ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the attached figure there are three circles with the same radius, and the three black dots are respectively located at the intersection points of pairs of circles, and also serve as the centers of the third circle. The three black dots form an equilateral triangle. The gray region consists of three crescent-shaped parts: each part is the remaining part of the overlap region of two circles after removing the central unshaded common overlap region of the three circles. Reasoning: Each circle has radius r=2. Because one intersection point of any two circles is the center of the third circle, the distance between any two centers is equal to the radius 2, so the three centers form an equilateral triangle with side length 2. First calculate the overlapping lens area of two circles with radius 2 and center distance 2: L = 2r^2 cos^{-1}(d/(2r)) - (d/2)√(4r^2-d^2) = 2·4·cos^{-1}(2/4) - 1·√(16-4) = 8·(π/3) - 2√3 = 8π/3 - 2√3. The central unshaded common region of the three circles is a Reuleaux triangle with side length/radius 2, whose area is: T = 2π - 2√3. Each gray part is equal to one two-circle lens area minus the central common region of the three circles, so the total area of the three gray parts is: 3(L - T) = 3[(8π/3 - 2√3) - (2π - 2√3)] = 3(2π/3) = 2π.

raw_record.question_text: Three circles with radius 2 are drawn in such a way that each time one of the points of intersection of two circles is identical with the centre of the third circle. How big is the area of the grey zone?

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as three congruent circles whose centers are the three black dots, with the shaded grey region consisting of the three pairwise-overlap parts outside the central unshaded three-circle intersection. From the text, use radius r=2 and the condition that an intersection point of any two circles is the center of the third, so the three centers form an equilateral triangle of side 2. Compute one two-circle lens area for equal circles of radius 2 separated by distance 2: L=2r^2 cos^{-1}(d/(2r))-(d/2)√(4r^2-d^2)=8π/3-2√3. Compute the central triple-overlap Reuleaux triangle area with side/radius 2: T=2π-2√3. Each grey component is one lens minus the central triple-overlap, so total grey area is 3(L-T)=3[(8π/3-2√3)-(2π-2√3)]=2π.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：附图中有三个同半径的圆，三个黑点分别位于两两圆的交点处，也作为第三个圆的圆心。三个黑点形成一个等边三角形。灰色区域由三个弯月形部分组成：每个部分是两个圆的重叠区域中，去掉中央未涂灰的三圆公共交叠区域之后剩下的部分。

推理：每个圆半径 r=2。因为任意两个圆的一个交点就是第三个圆的圆心，所以任意两个圆心之间的距离都等于半径 2，因此三个圆心构成边长为 2 的等边三角形。

先计算两个半径为 2、圆心距为 2 的圆的重叠透镜面积：
L = 2r^2 cos^{-1}(d/(2r)) - (d/2)√(4r^2-d^2)
= 2·4·cos^{-1}(2/4) - 1·√(16-4)
= 8·(π/3) - 2√3
= 8π/3 - 2√3。

中央未涂灰的三圆公共区域是边长/半径为 2 的 Reuleaux 三角形，其面积为：
T = 2π - 2√3。

每个灰色部分等于一个两圆透镜面积减去中央三圆公共区域，所以三个灰色部分总面积为：
3(L - T) = 3[(8π/3 - 2√3) - (2π - 2√3)]
= 3(2π/3)
= 2π。
